subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission process and template questions
messages:
From: Sana Qureshi <sana@sprucetech.co>
To: david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: Michael O'Neill <michael.oneill@vendorcorp.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Invoice submission workflow for Redwood

Hi David,

Thanks for the warm onboarding call yesterday. A few follow-ups from our AP team as we set SpruceTech up in your vendor system:

1) Preferred invoice submission: does Redwood require invoices to be uploaded to a vendor portal or is emailing invoices to an AP mailbox acceptable?
2) If portal is preferred, what is the portal URL and will we get a vendor ID?
3) Do you require a specific invoice template (line item structure, PO on the invoice, tax info)? Our system exports a simple PDF/CSV — can we just attach that?
4) Any other onboarding forms or tax docs needed (W-9 / W-8BEN / supplier questionnaire)?

I've attached a sample invoice (SpruceTech_SampleInvoice.pdf) so you can confirm formatting.

Appreciate a quick rundown so we can avoid payment delays.

Best,
Sana Qureshi
Finance Lead, SpruceTech Ltd.
Attachment: SpruceTech_SampleInvoice.pdf

From: david_kim@redwood.com <david_kim@redwood.com>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission workflow for Redwood

Hi Sana — great questions, thanks for sending the sample. TL;DR: portal preferred for fastest processing, email accepted in limited cases where a PO is present. Details below.

Portal vs Email
- Preferred: vendor portal (https://vendor-portal.redwood.com) — please create an account using the org email and I will approve the vendor record. Portal uploads get auto-matched to POs and go straight to AP for Net30 processing.
- Accepted: Email invoices to ap@redwood.com only if the invoice includes a valid PO number in the subject line (e.g., "INV 12345 / PO R-9987"). Email submissions are routed manually and add ~3–5 business days.

Required fields on invoice
- Redwood PO number (if a PO exists)
- Invoice date and number
- Line item descriptions and unit prices (subtotal, tax, total)
- Billing remittance address: Redwood Inference, 540 Bryant St, San Francisco, CA 94107

Onboarding forms
- Please complete the attached Vendor Onboarding Form and return. We also need a completed W-9 for US entities (or W-8BEN for non-US).

Attachments and sample templates
- I've attached our invoice template (Redwood_Invoice_Template.xlsx) and the Vendor Onboarding Form (Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf). Using your exported PDF is fine as long as the required fields above are present and, when a PO exists, the PO number is visible and in the subject line of any email.

Next steps
1) Fill and return the onboarding form + W-9.
2) Create portal account and request vendor approval (send me a quick note and I'll approve).
3) For the first invoice you can attach the sample PDF; once vendor is approved we recommend switching to portal uploads.

Happy to hop on a quick screen share if your AP system needs mapping.

Thanks,
David Kim
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0199
Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Template.xlsx; Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf

Hi all — jumping in from AP to confirm a couple of points so SpruceTech can be moved through onboarding without hiccups.

1) CSV uploads: the vendor portal currently supports CSV line-level uploads but it requires a mapping step. If you prefer CSV, please upload the CSV and include a sample mapping file (we'll send the mapping template once you request mapping). For immediate processing, PDF upload is fine — preference is a searchable PDF (no image-only scans).

2) PO handling: If a PO was issued to SpruceTech, the PO must be visible on the invoice and included in the portal metadata or email subject exactly as issued (case sensitive). Mismatched PO numbers are the most common cause of delays.

3) Tax docs: W-9 required for US vendors. We cannot pay until the onboarding form + W-9 are on file. If you have an outstanding DocuSign link, send it back signed and we can attach it to your vendor record.

4) Payment terms: Net30 from date of invoice receipt in the portal (or date invoice is acknowledged by AP if emailed) — note emailed invoices that require manual intervention will still be processed Net30 but may fall into the next AP run.

I'll send the CSV mapping spec to the portal contact once the vendor account is created. David — when you approve SpruceTech in the portal, can you loop me so I can trigger the mapping step?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Accounts Payable, Redwood Inference
Contact: ap@redwood.com

Thanks Sana — appreciate the quick turn. To summarize actions so nothing falls through:

- Sana / SpruceTech:
  * Complete Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf and attach your W-9 (or W-8BEN) — upload both to the portal or email them to ap@redwood.com with subject "Onboarding: SpruceTech / Vendor ID request".
  * Create portal account at https://vendor-portal.redwood.com and tell me the username so I can approve.
  * If you want CSV support, upload a representative CSV and we'll coordinate mapping with Laura.
- Redwood:
  * I will approve your vendor record once you create the portal account (expected same day).
  * Laura will send CSV mapping specs and confirm when the W-9 is on file.

Payment terms: Net30 from portal receipt. For the first invoice you may email the searchable PDF with the PO in the subject — we'll treat that as received but we strongly prefer portal uploads going forward to cut processing time.

Please confirm when the onboarding form + W-9 are uploaded and I'll fast-track the approval.

Cheers,
